name: s’Platzl
kurzbeschreibung: **Landeck’s s’Platzl** is the heart of the charming town, where locals and visitors alike gather to soak up the lively atmosphere. This picturesque square is framed by traditional **Tiroler** architecture, with half-timbered houses and cozy cafés inviting you to linger. Enjoy a cup of coffee or a slice of **Apfelstrudel** while watching the world go by. In winter, the square transforms into a festive hub with a **Christkindlmarkt**, while summer brings open-air concerts and cultural events. Whether you're strolling through the historic center or stopping for a bite at one of the nearby **Gasthöfe**, s’Platzl is the perfect spot to experience the warm, welcoming spirit of **Tirol**.
